Debtor.Creditor: The Hollow Syndicate of Tram Line Nine

Scars.Effect: A white line through the left brow; strangers remember the face.

Notes.Description: Brass-buttoned coat two sizes too big, a ticket punch on a chain, the habit of asking strangers for their fare. Dismissed after the Line Nine derailment and blamed for every pound of it.
Notes.Followers: Gillam, a bored conductor's boy: STR 6, lamp and whistle, paid 2s a day.
Notes.Notes: The Syndicate's collector visits on the first of each month. Lost 3 STR to a Mockery horse under Gasholder Row. The map to the Copper Vault is sewn into the coat lining.

Failed Careers.name: Tram Inspector
Failed Careers.description: Checked tickets on the electric lines until a derailment took the blame.

Stats.Creditor: The tram syndicate that pinned the derailment on you.
Stats.By money: With £3: a pass that opens any tram depot.
Stats.By HP: With 4 HP: a conductor's boy who still follows you.

Oddities.name: Humming Fare Token
Oddities.description: A copper token that warms when the holder walks toward the nearest working tram line, wherever they are.
